  SELECT lt.time
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
  WHERE r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC, lt.time ASC
  LIMIT 1
) AS lap_record
FROM circuits AS c
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
    WHERE r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  )
ORDER BY c.name;

ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC
